panels.description: Active Segment = segment with at least one measurement received in the last 15 minutes.

targets.query:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT segment.SegmentKey) AS value
FROM DimSegment segment
JOIN DimSite site
  ON site.SiteKey = segment.SiteKey
JOIN DimMeasurementLocation ml
  ON ml.SegmentKey = segment.SegmentKey
JOIN FactMeasurement f
  ON f.MeasurementLocationKey = ml.MeasurementLocationKey
WHERE site.SiteKey = CAST('$site' AS INTEGER)
  AND f.MeasurementTimestampUtc >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now', '-15 minutes');

panels.title: Active Segments

panels.description: Active Segment = segment with at least one measurement received in the last 15 minutes.

targets.query:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT segment.SegmentKey) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN f.MeasurementTimestampUtc >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now', '-15 minutes') THEN segment.SegmentKey
  END) AS value
FROM DimSegment segment
JOIN DimSite site
  ON site.SiteKey = segment.SiteKey
LEFT JOIN DimMeasurementLocation ml
  ON ml.SegmentKey = segment.SegmentKey
LEFT JOIN FactMeasurement f
  ON f.MeasurementLocationKey = ml.MeasurementLocationKey
WHERE site.SiteKey = CAST('$site' AS INTEGER);

targets.query:
SELECT
  latest.NumericValue AS value
FROM (
  SELECT f.NumericValue, f.MeasurementTimestampUtc
  FROM FactMeasurement f
  JOIN DimMeasurementLocation ml
    ON ml.MeasurementLocationKey = f.MeasurementLocationKey
  JOIN DimMeasurementLocationType mlt
    ON mlt.MeasurementLocationTypeKey = ml.MeasurementLocationTypeKey
  WHERE ml.SegmentKey = CAST('$segment' AS INTEGER)
    AND mlt.ShortName IN ('Load, Full Load Percentage')
    AND ml.ValueClass = 'Percentage'
  ORDER BY f.MeasurementTimestampUtc DESC, ml.MeasurementLocationName
  LIMIT 1
) latest;

targets.query:
SELECT
  (
    SELECT f.NumericValue
    FROM FactMeasurement f
    JOIN DimMeasurementLocation ml
      ON ml.MeasurementLocationKey = f.MeasurementLocationKey
    JOIN DimMeasurementLocationType mlt
      ON mlt.MeasurementLocationTypeKey = ml.MeasurementLocationTypeKey
    WHERE ml.SegmentKey = CAST('$segment' AS INTEGER)
      AND mlt.ShortName = 'Total kW'
    ORDER BY f.MeasurementTimestampUtc DESC, ml.MeasurementLocationName
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS 'Real Power',
  (
    SELECT f.NumericValue
    FROM FactMeasurement f
    JOIN DimMeasurementLocation ml
      ON ml.MeasurementLocationKey = f.MeasurementLocationKey
    JOIN DimMeasurementLocationType mlt
      ON mlt.MeasurementLocationTypeKey = ml.MeasurementLocationTypeKey
    WHERE ml.SegmentKey = CAST('$segment' AS INTEGER)
      AND mlt.ShortName = 'Total kVAR'
    ORDER BY f.MeasurementTimestampUtc DESC, ml.MeasurementLocationName
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS 'Reactive Power',
  (
    SELECT f.NumericValue
    FROM FactMeasurement f
    JOIN DimMeasurementLocation ml
      ON ml.MeasurementLocationKey = f.MeasurementLocationKey
    JOIN DimMeasurementLocationType mlt
      ON mlt.MeasurementLocationTypeKey = ml.MeasurementLocationTypeKey
    WHERE ml.SegmentKey = CAST('$segment' AS INTEGER)
      AND mlt.ShortName = 'Total kVA'
    ORDER BY f.MeasurementTimestampUtc DESC, ml.MeasurementLocationName
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS 'Apparent Power';

targets.query:
WITH configured_energy_cost AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(rate.SettingValue AS REAL) AS RatePerKwh
  FROM ApplicationSetting rate
  JOIN ApplicationSetting currency
    ON currency.SettingKey = 'EnergyCost.CurrencyUomUuid'
  JOIN DimUnit currency_unit
    ON currency_unit.UnitUuid = currency.SettingValue
  JOIN DimUomQuantity currency_quantity

    f.NumericValue AS PowerKw
  FROM FactMeasurement f
  JOIN DimMeasurementLocation ml

  JOIN DimMeasurementLocationType mlt
    ON mlt.MeasurementLocationTypeKey = ml.MeasurementLocationTypeKey

FROM configured_energy_cost
